neighbours.label: the word that turns a contrast after 'but' or 'however': not, no, while, unlike, whereas
fire: The engineers said the bridge was safe, but the report contains no data by which it may be checked.
The author praises the reforms at length. However, while the tax fell, the debt grew.
The first group favors a gradual change in the law. But whereas that group stresses cost, the second stresses fairness.
He was a gifted speaker, but as a careful scholar, not a popular preacher.
The new drug was tested on many patients last year. However, unlike the older one, it has few side effects.
The evidence, however, pointed to a wider problem, not just a local shortage.
The farmers were told the well was clean, but tests showed there was no trace of the promised filter.
The mayor made many promises about housing. But the city is not any closer to building it.
quiet: The engineers said the bridge was safe, and the report contains data by which it may be checked.
The author praises the reforms at length. However, the tax fell and the debt grew.
The first group favors a gradual change in the law. That group stresses cost, and the second stresses fairness.
He was a gifted speaker and a careful scholar, and also a popular preacher.
The new drug was tested on many patients last year. However, the older one has few side effects.
The evidence pointed to a wider problem, and to a local shortage as well.
The farmers were told the well was clean, and tests showed a trace of the promised filter.
The mayor made many promises about housing. The city is now closer to building it.

notes: Short sentences with a bare 'not' stayed under 0.1 in probes; the pole seems to need a claim set up first. Two near misses keep 'However,' without a contrast word.
